method: Decoded all 3642 frames (ffmpeg -fps_mode passthrough, scale 320x180 area, rgb24, nice 10). Computed per-pair scores at 160x90: mean abs RGB diff, HSV 16x4x8 histogram L1/2, edge change ratio, 10x10 block-change fraction, and motion-compensated block residual (80x40, +/-6 px). A generous candidate set of 1064 frames was built: mad>12 | hist>0.25 | ECR>0.55 | block>0.35 | mad >3x median of +/-12 frames (and >3) | hist >3x local median (and >0.08) | ECR >2.5x local median (and >0.25). On top of the candidates, EVERY frame was inspected visually on 100-frame filmstrips (160x90) with metric hits highlighted. The only exceptions are the static stretches 100-499 and 1300-1699, viewed at every 2nd frame; metrics there show no spikes besides 224, 400, 1408 and 1427. All action passages (2017-2110, 2190-2210, 2498-2615, 2718-3013, 3128-3160, 3200-3318, 3346-3373, 3398-3641) were re-inspected frame by frame at 240-320 px. Each hard cut was verified on n-1 | n | n+1 sheets at 320 px (/tmp/gt/sheets/dbs_cuts_01..05.png), and the doubtful cases on /tmp/gt/sheets/dbs_doubts_01.png. Long shots (>6 s) were all viewed at every frame or every 2nd frame. Note: the second half is a stylised flashback fight with fluid camera work; there, only clear changes of camera setup were counted as cuts.
pts_note: pts are regular: deltas are 41/42 ms only (time_base 1/1000; ms rounding of 1001/24). start_time is 0. Decoded frames = 3642 = ffprobe frames. t_ms = pts - pts[0] = pts.
notable_non_cuts: Within-shot events that are NOT cuts: 520-614 (tractor passes a low camera), 853-866 (stump swing), 1065-1076 (Goten flies at camera), 1182-1233, 2017-2030 (arms swing apart and reveal the face), 2060-2064 (yellow flash; same framing after), 2098-2109 (white flash and debris; same framing), 2199-2200 (white flash), 2201-2212 (aura burst), 2503-2512 (zoom-out), 2550-2583 (push-in past Goku to reveal Frieza), 2722-2730 (aura flare), 2747-2808 and 2809-2892 (orbiting camera with Frieza attacks), 2899-3031 (Frieza knocked back; camera follows the disc to Goku), 3136-3149 (power-up flash with zoom), 3155-3157 and 3207-3215 (aura growth and lightning), 3352-3369 (auras cross and leave the frame), 3387-3403 (Goku crashes into the sky shot; explosion).
